top_signals.title: Australian Private Credit Firm Metrics Cuts Value of Three Funds
top_signals.summary: Metrics Credit Partners, a major Australian private debt firm, reduced the value of assets across three listed funds by about A$169 million ($119 million) and halted trading of the vehicles.
